correctness.rationale: For n>=3 uniform involutions, the adjacent-label map that exchanges two fixed singleton cycles with their transposition, otherwise conjugates by (j,j+1), is a genuine involution. Case analysis shows that it toggles D_j while preserving the entire remote fixed-indicator vector, proving joint (not just pairwise) independence within every admissible fiber. Conditioning on a local fixed site counts (j-1)T_(n-3) or (n-j-1)T_(n-3) favorable pairings; the telephone recurrence gives the exact two-diagonal covariance matrix, Cov(F,D_j)=-T_(n-2)/T_n, and endpoint/interior distinctions, with interior n=3 equality. Verified independently by exhaustive enumeration of every involution n=3..8, fiber by fiber and rational covariance entry by entry; finite tests support but do not replace the bijection.

originality.rationale: The novelty assessed is the remote-FIXED-LOCATION joint independence and complete site-specific covariance matrix, not classical univariate involution Eulerian numbers or aggregate fixed-count/descents identities. Chow's 2008 involution Eulerian enumerators retain total fixed counts, not the vector of named fixed statuses. The nearest published result for uniform *permutations* has a different law and Cov(F,D)=-1/n, and does not cover the involution conditional fibers. Relevant older descent-set/cycle-type algebra is a residual potential for an implicit positional specialization.
residual_risks: More refined position-marked involution descent enumerators may implicitly give the same all-fiber statement.
The n=3 interior zero boundary and distinction from uniform full permutations must be retained.
